title: SLS Common Record Metadata
description: Shared provenance, review, licensing, and schema-version metadata for SLS linguistic records.

contributor.description: Person or organization responsible for adding the record.

reviewers.description: People who reviewed the linguistic record.

source.description: A citable source or an explicit description of the record's origin.

date_added.description: ISO 8601 calendar date on which the record entered the repository.

date_modified.description: ISO 8601 calendar date of the record's latest substantive change.

review_status.description: The record's current review lifecycle state.

license.description: License applied to SLS linguistic data records.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema used to encode this record.

since_version.description: First repository release containing the record.
